name: terylon
description: Terylon — internal Claude Code plugin marketplace. Role-based plugins for development on top of Azure DevOps.

plugins.name: terylon-git
plugins.description: Git-only foundation — worktree isolation, the review engine, and the multi-lens code reviewer. No forge, no MCP server; works in any git repository.

plugins.name: terylon-metrics
plugins.description: Claude Code run metrics — per-agent, per-tier token-spend measurement read from a session's own transcripts. No git, forge, or MCP dependency.

plugins.name: terylon-devops
plugins.description: Azure DevOps layer — ADO mechanics, PR review and description, comment handling. Adds the forge transport on top of terylon-git.

plugins.name: terylon-product
plugins.description: Product owner / PM — authoring User Stories grounded in the codebase and Feature specifications with a UX section. Requires terylon-devops.

plugins.name: terylon-dev
plugins.description: Developer pipeline — from a user story to implemented, tested code through plan → build (TDD) → finish, with an autonomous leader agent and parallel review lenses. Requires terylon-git, terylon-devops, terylon-metrics and superpowers.

plugins.name: terylon-test
plugins.description: Tester — walks a pull request's test plan and its linked work item's acceptance criteria, exercises what can be exercised, reconciles the two, and reports what cannot. Separates executed from asserted so a tick means something. Requires terylon-devops and terylon-metrics.
